summary: CKGSB's marketing team is in a critical push to launch the Intelligent China webpage this week while advancing the China Going-Global report and redesigning the knowledge website, with immediate attention needed on finalizing copy changes and press release edits.
summaryDetail: The most urgent priority is driving traffic to the Intelligent China webpage launching this week, which requires Jay and Cao Yi to implement Manaferra's suggested copy changes and Alan, Renee, and Xin to review the full rewrite of the Emerging Tech Management Week webpage. In parallel, the China Going-Global report is moving forward: Felix must share the press release with the marketing team for edits, and Julie needs to review a draft email about the new report for Zongchao, with the press release title now changed to 'CKGSB-IE University Report Reveals New Models'. The knowledge website redesign is also progressing, with Joseph sharing the HTML file, the team meeting to provide specific feedback, and Joker making changes based on that feedback and own judgment. Looking ahead, the team must draft a plan for target areas and prompts, analyze existing participant profiles, and audit conversion tracking setup to support the prioritized Asia Star and Intelligent China programs, while also preparing for the Tech in Asia luncheon on September 15, including confirming alumni speakers and keeping Dean Xiang's keynote to 10 minutes. Additionally, routine IT issues like Outlook account lockouts have been resolved, but the team should ensure all devices are updated to prevent future disruptions.
